dish_en: home-style Kung Pao chicken with cucumber and carrot
product_desc: raw skinless chicken breast fillets on a dark plate, pale pink and smooth
cook: a home cook in their forties, apron over a plain shirt, the unhurried competence of someone who has made this a hundred times
kitchen: a warm Chinese home kitchen, wood cabinets, a gas wok range, a few jars of seasoning on an open shelf, afternoon light from the left
prep_subject: diced chicken in a bowl, glossy from a corn starch marinade, and beside it two separate piles of vegetables cut to the same size as the chicken: bright orange carrot dice and pale green cucumber dice with the skin left on. Behind them a small bowl of roasted peanuts, a dish of whole dried red chillies with Sichuan peppercorns, and a bowl of dark pre-mixed sauce with a spoon standing in it
prep_defines: the matching dice size of chicken, carrot and cucumber, and the fact that the sauce is already mixed in its own bowl before any heat
cook_subject: the wok partway through the stir fry, chicken dice turned opaque and gold at the edges among blackened dried chillies, orange carrot dice softening among them, the cucumber not yet added and the peanuts not yet added. A dark glossy sauce is just beginning to coat everything
cook_negatives: peanuts added early and gone soft, cucumber added early and gone grey and limp, sauce improvised into the wok instead of pre-mixed, chicken with pink at the centre, a thin watery sauce, bell peppers, onion wedges, cashews instead of peanuts
hero_subject: the finished dish in a shallow bowl, glossy dark-glazed chicken dice with bright orange carrot and pale green cucumber still distinct and crisp, whole dried chillies and roasted peanuts sitting on top rather than buried, chopped spring onion scattered over, a bowl of plain rice beside it
hero_setting: a warm home dining table, a bowl of steamed rice slightly out of focus behind
story: dried chillies and Sichuan peppercorns bloomed in the oil before anything else
chicken, then carrot, then cucumber, then the pre-mixed sauce thickening in seconds
peanuts stirred in last off the heat, then bowled and served
negatives_global: bell peppers, onion wedges, cashews instead of peanuts, peanuts stirred in early and gone soft, cucumber gone grey and limp, a thin watery sauce, chicken pink at the centre, restaurant kitchen, plastic packaging, sealed tray, product label, printed nutrition panel, barcode
first_heat: The dried chillies and Sichuan peppercorns darken almost at once in the hot oil and a sharp fragrant smoke lifts off the surface of the wok.
transform: the chicken dice turn from pink and translucent to opaque white-gold on every face, the carrot dice soften and deepen in colour, the cucumber dice go in last and stay bright and crisp, and the pre-mixed sauce is poured in and thickens from thin and dark to glossy in a few seconds, clinging to every piece. No peanuts are in the wok at any point in this clip.
lift: A wok spatula enters from the left, lifts a portion of glazed chicken, carrot and cucumber clear of the wok and holds it at the centre of frame. Sauce runs off in slow glossy threads and the three components stay visibly separate in colour.
plate: The hands of <Subject 1> enter from the top of frame holding the wok by its handle, tip it once over the bowl, and the chicken, carrot, cucumber and dried chillies slide out together with the thick sauce following. The hands withdraw out of frame.
final_lift: A hand enters from the right holding chopsticks, takes one glazed chicken cube with a peanut resting against it, lifts it clear of the bowl and holds it steady at the centre of frame, sauce running slowly from it.
sound_01: A warm home kitchen with a low room tone. In the first shot, a ceramic bowl sliding on a wooden counter. In the second shot, diced vegetables being swept into two separate piles and a spoon stirring the pre-mixed sauce in its bowl. In the third shot, a gas burner rising, then dried chillies and peppercorns hitting hot oil with a sharp crackle. No speech.
sound_02: A continuous stir fry throughout, the scrape of a spatula against carbon steel. In the second shot the sound changes twice as the carrot goes in and again as the cucumber follows, then the sauce hits hot metal with a hiss and settles into a thick slow bubble. No speech.
sound_03: A home kitchen. In the first shot, chicken and vegetables sliding into a ceramic bowl with the sauce following slowly. In the second shot, the dry rattle of roasted peanuts landing on top of the glaze. In the third shot, chopsticks closing, and a rice bowl set down on wood. No speech.
music: A bright domestic bed: plucked strings with a pentatonic figure over light percussion, cheerful and familiar without being twee.

beats.c1s1: <Subject 1> draws the bowl of marinated chicken, the two piles of diced carrot and cucumber and the bowl of pre-mixed sauce toward them across the counter in one movement.
beats.c1s2: Both hands of <Subject 1> gather the diced carrot and cucumber into two separate piles rather than one, keeping them apart because they go into the wok at different moments, and slide them to the near edge beside the bowl of marinated chicken and the already-mixed sauce.
beats.c1s3: The hands of <Subject 1> enter from the top of frame carrying the dish of whole dried red chillies and Sichuan peppercorns, tip them into the hot oil first, before any other ingredient, and withdraw straight up out of frame empty.
beats.c3s2: The hand of <Subject 1> enters from the top of frame holding the small bowl of roasted peanuts, scatters them once across the surface in a single pass, and withdraws straight up out of frame. The peanuts land last and stay whole and dry on top of the glaze rather than being stirred under it, so they keep their crunch.

clip02_shot1: [Shot 1] Locked-off close-up at wok height, 50mm feel, continuing directly from <Picture 1>. The wok of <Picture 4> fills the lower two thirds of frame over its burner, which stays visible at the bottom of frame throughout. The dried chillies and Sichuan peppercorns from clip 01 have darkened in the oil and are giving off a sharp fragrant smoke. The hands of <Subject 1> enter from the top of frame carrying the bowl of starch-marinated chicken dice from <Picture 3>, exactly the size that image defines, tip them in among the chillies in one movement, and withdraw straight up out of frame empty. The dice settle against the hot steel and the sizzle deepens as they land. The camera does not move at any point in this shot, and the framing does not drift.
